name: subscribe__max_interval_in_response
description: Locks the negotiated cadence value the bridge advertises to the peer. The peer's SubscribeRequest carries MinIntervalFloor + MaxIntervalCeiling; the bridge's SubscribeResponse carries the negotiated MaxInterval (Matter §10.6.5 MaxInterval field of SubscribeResponseMessage). The scenario asserts the bridge's response carries MaxInterval=60 — matching the harness's hard-coded ceiling for peer-driven subscribes. Catches a regression where the bridge writes a smaller value (clamp regression) or omits the field entirely (Apple Home falls back to its internal default, the heartbeat cadence drifts).
